You don't need a new project.
Just swap the component.

Modern CSS can replace JavaScript for interactions you thought required React state, effects, and event handlers. This is a showcase of measured trade-offs for senior frontend developers at React-first teams.

This modal uses zero JavaScript

It's powered by commandfor + command attributes and <dialog closedby>. No useState, no event handlers, no "use client".

This component is a React Server Component. Close with the × button or click outside.

For React teams shipping to real users

You don't need to rewrite your app. When the performance trade-off is worth it, swap individual components: one <Modal>, one carousel, one tooltip.

Each feature page shows measured bundle size, main-thread time, and Interaction to Next Paint (INP) costs, plus an honest verdict on browser support and complexity.

The component kit is designed for gradual adoption: React Server Components, CSS in cascade layers for easy theming, and clear fallback guidance.
